_comment: Schema for a thesis record. Matches what capture.py writes, so anything produced in chat can be dropped into data/theses.real/ in the repository.
claim: One sentence, quantified, in your own words. Never copied from the source.
mechanism: The causal chain the author asserts.
kill_criteria: A specific observation, from a publisher who releases on a schedule, with a date.
source_document: The document that would answer this, e.g. 'FY2026 Form 10-K, segment revenue table'
